crossRefs.note: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.
Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be.…

parallels.note: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”
translations.bsb: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”
translations.kjv: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
translations.asv: And some of them stood there, when they heard it, said, This man calleth Elijah.
